syntax.children_note: Void element: never has contents. An end tag must not be written; a trailing "/" in the start tag is permitted and ignored.

placement.note: Records named-parent/ancestor requirements relevant here; null is not permission to place the element anywhere. All element content models, transparent models, template contexts, and other conformance restrictions still apply. This taxonomy is not a full nesting validator.

flags.issue: Their definitions list Flow (and Phrasing for area) unconditionally; only the non-normative category index states the condition.
flags.resolution: Recorded as conditional, with the condition taken from the category index.
